text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, yeah.
I see, is it already that time of year...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back. Kinda makes me wanna see
Ma drivin' that tractor again after all this time."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, aah~! It's fine then!
Today is, um, err... my day off, after all!"
